info.name: kotlin
info.category: Managed — JVM bytecode (also Native, JS, Wasm)
info.typing: Statically and strongly typed; pervasive type inference; nullability in the type system
info.gc: Yes — inherited from the JVM target
info.design_notes: Kotlin on the JVM compiles to bytecode and inherits HotSpot's JIT, so steady-state performance tracks Java closely. Inline functions and value classes can avoid boxing. Kotlin/Native is a separate AOT backend for environments where the JVM isn't available.
key_traits: Performance parity with Java in steady state
Inline lambdas + value classes reduce allocation pressure
Nullability checks are compile-time only (no runtime cost)
